name: oauth_token_refresh
description:
Refresh the access_token of an auth.oauth pod using its stored refresh_token. The tool reads refresh_token + client credentials at courier scope, POSTs to the provider's token endpoint (per the pod's metadata), and updates the access_token env var in place. The next http_request that resolves `datapod:auth.oauth:<id>/access_token` picks up the new value automatically. Returns metadata only (provider, new expiry, success) — tokens never enter your transcript.

Use before calling an authenticated API when the current access token may be expired. Pass `force=true` to refresh regardless of stored expiry.

inputs.name: force
inputs.description: If true, refresh even if the stored expiry suggests the token is still valid. Default false — the tool short-circuits when the token isn't near expiry.

outputs.description: Status summary: provider, new expiry, whether refresh actually fired or short-circuited.
Structured payload: ok, provider, refreshed (bool), new_expiry_iso, expires_in_seconds, refresh_token_rotated (bool).

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for oauth_token_refresh:
pod_id: str          # the auth.oauth pod URI
force: bool = False  # refresh even if not near expiry

metadata.planner_description: Refresh an OAuth access token. Pod-aware; tokens never enter the LLM transcript. Use before authenticated API calls when expiry is near.
